criteria.description: Undo takes off the last round: the totals go back and the next storyteller is whoever told the undone round
criteria.verification: game.test.ts undoLast cases (totals, storyteller, storyteller changed on the round screen)

criteria.description: Undo can be used again and again, down to a game with no rounds
criteria.verification: game.test.ts: undo twice and undo back to round 0; manual: undo three rounds in a row

criteria.description: Undo on the winner view reopens the game: a win at the finish loses the winning round, End game is simply taken back
criteria.verification: game.test.ts undo after End game and after a win at the finish; manual: both winner views show the right Undo label and reopen the game

criteria.description: After Undo the bunnies hop back one stone at a time; Skip (tap or button) and reduced motion still work
criteria.verification: choreography.test.ts negative gains; board-input.test.ts undoPlay; manual: undo in Chrome, then with Skip, then with reduced motion

criteria.description: The game is saved after every round; reopening the app offers Resume and lands on the same screen with the same entered votes, without replaying hops
criteria.verification: game-store.test.ts save then a new store reads it back with view and draft; manual: reload mid-round and on the scores screen

criteria.description: Finished games appear in a history (date, players, final scores) reachable from Home, at most 10, each deletable with two taps
criteria.verification: game-store.test.ts recordFinished, cap of 10, deleteHistory; manual: Past games screen and two-tap delete at 390 px and 320 px

criteria.description: Broken or old saved games and history never crash the app: players survive, only broken parts are dropped, newer data is never written over
criteria.verification: game-data.test.ts broken-data table and newer-version cases; game-store.test.ts broken game key leaves players alone and newer game is not overwritten

criteria.description: Typecheck, tests and build pass locally and in CI
criteria.verification: npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run build locally; PR checks green

criteria.description: Redo puts back what Undo took (a round or End game), in reverse order of undoing; a new round or End game clears it; it survives closing the app
criteria.verification: game.test.ts redoNext cases; game-data.test.ts Redo list loading; manual: Undo then Redo a round and End game in Chrome
